Allowed fitting code: solve, qr, chol, crossprod, %*%, lgamma, digamma, trigamma, dnbinom, plogis, qlogis, model.frame, model.matrix, model.response, model.offset, Formula package, numDeriv::hessian (standard errors ). NB: IRLS beta alternated Newton-Raphson log(theta). ZINB: EM algorithm; M-steps IRLS (weighted logistic fractional response tau + NB fit prior weights 1 - tau). EM must never decrease observed-data log-likelihood. MASS::glm.nb, pscl::zeroinfl glm may used tests/, inst/benchmark/, report, comparison. Follow equations project-docs/STA651_Final_Project.pdf, Section 3. Comment estimation code equation implements. Explain reasoning ; must able explain every line.

text: Without |, zinbreg() uses covariates parts, zeroinfl() . Offsets can given offset argument (count part) offset() either part formula.
code: library(nbzinbJia) data("bioChemists", package = "pscl")  # Negative binomial regression nb <- nbreg(art ~ fem + mar + kid5 + phd + ment, data = bioChemists) summary(nb) #>             Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|) #> (Intercept)   0.2561     0.1373  1.8649   0.0622 #> femWomen     -0.2164     0.0726 -2.9795   0.0029 #> marMarried    0.1505     0.0821  1.8331   0.0668 #> kid5         -0.1764     0.0528 -3.3404   0.0008 #> phd           0.0153     0.0359  0.4257   0.6703 #> ment          0.0291     0.0032  9.0477   0.0000 #> Theta: 2.2644   Log-likelihood: -1560.958 on 7 Df  # Zero-inflated NB: count covariates | zero-inflation covariates zinb <- zinbreg(art ~ fem + mar + kid5 + phd + ment | ment,                 data = bioChemists) summary(zinb)$coefficients$zero #>             Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|) #> (Intercept)  -0.8067     0.3532 -2.2840   0.0224 #> ment         -0.6095     0.2458 -2.4797   0.0131  # Model comparison and prediction c(NB = AIC(nb), ZINB = AIC(zinb)) #>     NB   ZINB #> 3135.9 3124.5  nd <- data.frame(fem = "Women", mar = "Married", kid5 = 0, phd = 3,                  ment = c(0, 10, 30)) predict(zinb, newdata = nd, type = "zero")   # P(structural zero) #>      1      2      3 #> 0.3086 0.0010 0.0000

what: Negative binomial regression by IRLS and Newton-Raphson — nbreg
title: Negative binomial regression by IRLS and Newton-Raphson — nbreg
text: Fits NB2 regression model log(mu) = X beta + offset, Var(Y) = mu + mu^2 / theta. regression coefficients updated iteratively reweighted least squares (Fisher scoring) theta held fixed, log(theta) updated Newton-Raphson beta held fixed. two steps alternate log-likelihood converges. general-purpose optimizer used. results reproduce MASS::glm.nb().

what: Zero-inflated negative binomial regression by EM with IRLS M-steps — zinbreg
title: Zero-inflated negative binomial regression by EM with IRLS M-steps — zinbreg
text: Fits ZINB model: probability pi observation structural zero, otherwise follows NB2 distribution mean mu, log(mu) = X beta + offset logit(pi) = Z gamma. observed-data log-likelihood maximized EM algorithm. E-step computes posterior probability zero structural; M-step fits logistic regression fractional response (IRLS) weighted NB regression (IRLS beta, Newton-Raphson theta). general-purpose optimizer used. Standard errors come analytic observed information matrix (beta, gamma, log(theta)). results reproduce pscl::zeroinfl(..., dist = "negbin").

text: epsilon Convergence tolerance EM algorithm: iterations stop observed-data log-likelihood changes less epsilon. EM converges linearly (slowly), small change log-likelihood can still leave parameters noticeably away MLE; default 1e-10 gives coefficients accurate 1e-5. maxit Maximum number EM iterations. inner_maxit Maximum number iterations IRLS / Newton-Raphson loop inside M-steps. trace Logical; TRUE, print observed-data log-likelihood EM iteration. theta_max Upper bound theta (see nbreg_control()). theta_warn warning issued estimated theta exceeds value.
